power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: Creepers bẹru rẹ ati ki o yoo ko sunmọ.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Mu 0.5 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti omi tabi ojo - irun tutu jẹ ibanujẹ.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Burns agbara 30% yiyara ju eniyan lọ.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: A nrin odi ti irin ati ki o yoo - fere immovable, sugbon o lọra ati ki o jẹ ipalara si ooru.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Yẹ Resistance I - irin plating shrugs pa fe paapaa nigba ti unequipped.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Towering fireemu
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: O jẹ 30% tobi ju ẹrọ orin deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: Ajesara si majele, gbigbẹ, ati ebi.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: Gbigbe 25% losokepupo ju eniyan deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: O gba 80% ibajẹ diẹ sii lati ina, lava, ati olubasọrọ block magma - irin ṣe itọju ooru.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Iho apata
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Dide ni dudu ti o jinlẹ - njẹ okuta aise, o jẹun nipasẹ irin pẹlu ọwọ igboro, ṣugbọn o gbẹ ni imọlẹ oorun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Awọn oju ni ibamu si okunkun jinlẹ - ko si awọn ògùṣọ ti nilo. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: O mọ bi o ṣe le de lori ilẹ ti ko ni deede. Ko gba bibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: Fi opin si gbogbo awọn bulọọki lemeji bi sare - okuta ti nso si awọn ọwọ faramọ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: Awọn ọwọ igboro mi bi okuta pickaxe - fọ awọn irin ati okuta laisi awọn irinṣẹ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: Lakoko ti Orire n ṣiṣẹ (ti a funni nipasẹ jijẹ diamond), awọn bulọọki irin silẹ bi ẹni ti o wa pẹlu Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: Okuta Onje
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Le jẹ cobblestone, okuta, granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, basalt, ati blackstone fun ounje iwonba. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: Olu Diet
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: Warped ati Crimson elu jẹ ounjẹ to dara ni Nether - tẹ-ọtun lati jẹun fun ebi 5 ati itẹlọrun 0.6. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Le je Ejò ingots, aise Ejò, Ejò irin, deepslate Ejò irin, ati aise Ejò ohun amorindun - a ina onje laarin okuta ati irin. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Irin palate
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Le je irin ingots, irin aise, irin nuggets, irin irin, deepslate irin irin, ati aise irin ohun amorindun - kan to dara onje fun a miner. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: Gilded Palate
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Le jẹ awọn ingots goolu, goolu aise, awọn eso goolu, irin goolu, irin goolu ti o jinlẹ, irin goolu, ati awọn bulọọki goolu aise - ohun elo ti o pọ sii. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Le jẹ awọn okuta iyebiye, okuta iyebiye, ati irin diamond ti o jinlẹ - ti o ṣe afiwe si karọọti goolu ni itẹlọrun. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Le jẹ awọn emeralds, emerald ore, ati deepslate emerald ore - ounjẹ ti o dara julọ ni kukuru ti netherite. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
Le jẹ awọn ingots netherite, alokuirin, ati awọn idoti atijọ - ounjẹ ọlọrọ julọ ni agbaye. Ko ni lọ silẹ lori ikun ni kikun.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Njẹ Ejò funni ni Mimi Omi I fun awọn aaya 60.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Njẹ iron ṣe iranlọwọ Haste I fun awọn aaya 60.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Njẹ awọn ifunni goolu Iyara I fun awọn iṣẹju 2.
Njẹ Diamond funni ni Luck II fun awọn iṣẹju 5 - jẹ ki Mining Fortune ṣiṣẹ lakoko ti nṣiṣe lọwọ.
Njẹ emerald funni ni Resistance Ina fun awọn iṣẹju 5 - imọlẹ oorun si tun ṣeto ọ, ṣugbọn ko le sun ọ mọ.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Njẹ netherite funni ni Agbara I ati Resistance I fun iṣẹju marun 5.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Mu ina ati ki o gba ipalara 1 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% iwọn ti ẹrọ orin deede - awọn eefin wiwọ jẹ rọrun.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: Ẹmi ti igbo atijọ - iyara laarin awọn igi, ti o nifẹ nipasẹ awọn ẹranko igbẹ, ati pe o ni anfani lati di awọn ọta pẹlu igbi ti awọn gbongbo. Larada nipa ojo, ṣugbọn awọn Nether jona.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Ọkan Pẹlu Iseda
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Awọn onijagidijagan ti o korira fi ọ silẹ nikan - wọn gbẹsan nikan ti o ba kọlu.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Laiyara larada lakoko olubasọrọ pẹlu omi.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Gba igbelaruge iyara lakoko ti o wa ninu igbo biomes.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Mu 1 bibajẹ fun iṣẹju kan nigba ti Nether biomes. Awọn bata orunkun Frost Walker ni kikun ṣe idiwọ ibajẹ naa.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: Dragoni-ẹjẹ ati ẹru - ajesara si ina ati ẹru si awọn ẹranko, ṣugbọn ina gbigbona n jo nipasẹ agbara ni iyara.
Ajesara si ina, lava, magma, ati sisun - dragoni-ẹjẹ nṣiṣẹ gbona.
Wẹ nipasẹ lava ni irọrun bi awọn miiran ti we nipasẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: O rii kedere nipasẹ lava, laisi kurukuru ati owusuwusu sisun - awọn ijinle didà ko tọju ohunkohun.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: Wing Kushion
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Awọn iyẹ vestigial fọ isubu rẹ - ko gba ibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: Pupọ julọ awọn ẹda palolo - ẹran-ọsin, awọn ara abule, ẹranko igbẹ - sa fun wiwa nla rẹ.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: Iwontunwonsi
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: 20% tobi ju ẹrọ orin deede - o nira lati padanu.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Awọn adehun 2 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Mu bibajẹ 1.5 fun iṣẹju kan ninu omi tabi ojo - ina nilo lati simi.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: An undead alarinkiri ti o alakoso nipasẹ ọrọ ati ki o ju boluti ti withering rot - ko le rì ki o si ri ninu òkunkun, sugbon larada laiyara ati iná ni orun.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Sọsọtọ bi undead. Ipalara nipasẹ Ilera Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, mu larada nipasẹ Bibajẹ Lẹsẹkẹsẹ, ajesara si Majele.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: Ko nilo lati simi. Le ye laelae labẹ omi.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Le ri kedere ni lapapọ òkunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Mu ina ati ki o gba ibaje 2 fun iṣẹju kan nigbati o farahan si imọlẹ orun taara.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Isọdọtun ilera adayeba ti dinku si 40% ti deede.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: Kekere
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: Kekere ni giga ṣugbọn iyara ati nimble - gun ohunkohun, fa awọn ohun kan, ṣugbọn lu bi iye.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: Idinku
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.description: 50% awọn iwọn ti a deede player.
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Dada Dimu
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Le ṣe iwọn odi eyikeyi pẹlu irọrun.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Scurry
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: Gbigbe 20% yiyara ju eniyan deede lọ.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: Ki kekere ti ja bo ti awọ ọrọ. Ko gba bibajẹ isubu.
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: Awọn nkan ṣe ifamọra lati ijinna nla.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: Awọn adehun 2 kere si bibajẹ fun buruju.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: Ìyọnu Tiny
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Ebi npa 80% yiyara - awọn ara kekere sun ounjẹ ni kiakia.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Iho Dragon
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: Dragoni ti ina ati okuta, ti a bi jin labẹ aye. Ṣe rere ninu ooru ati okunkun, o si dagba si agbara kikun rẹ lori akoko.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Iho Dragon Fọọmù
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: Mu apẹrẹ ti dragoni iho apata - ẹda ti magma ati ojiji. Awọn abuda dragoni rẹ, idagbasoke, ati awọn agbara ni iṣakoso nipasẹ Iwalaaye Dragon.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Igbo Dragon
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: Dragoni ti gbongbo ati ẹgun, ni ile laarin awọn igi atijọ. Alaisan ati resilient, o dagba ni okun sii bi o ti dagba.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: Forest Dragon Fọọmù
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: Mu apẹrẹ ti dragoni igbo - ẹda ti ajara ati oró. Awọn abuda dragoni rẹ, idagbasoke, ati awọn agbara ni iṣakoso nipasẹ Iwalaaye Dragon.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: Òkun Dragon
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: A dragoni ti ṣiṣan ati iji, bi si awọn ìmọ omi. Yiyara labẹ awọn igbi, o wa sinu agbara ni kikun pẹlu ọjọ ori.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Òkun Dragon Fọọmù
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: Mu apẹrẹ ti dragoni okun - ẹda ti lọwọlọwọ ati monomono. Awọn abuda dragoni rẹ, idagbasoke, ati awọn agbara ni iṣakoso nipasẹ Iwalaaye Dragon.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Lefiatani
